description: This file contains functions for loading and processing behavioral event data into SQLite databases, including creating tables, inserting event records, and handling aggregated events for a behavioral observation software project.

methods.name: load_events_in_db
methods.description: Populates an in-memory SQLite database with event data from specified observations, subjects, and behaviors, creating appropriate tables and indexes.

methods.name: load_aggregated_events_in_db
methods.description: Creates an in-memory SQLite database with aggregated event data, combining multiple events into start/stop intervals and handling point and state behaviors.
